title: How area-based marketing is reimagining CTV | Taptap Digital

facts.fact: Per Statista (a third-party source cited by the page), predicted advertising spend is set to exceed $42 billion by 2028.
facts.quote: predicted advertising spend is set to exceed $42 billion by 2028, these can be profitable areas to address. Source: Statista.

facts.fact: Per an eMarketer survey cited by the page (a third-party source), top CTV advertising pain points included measurement and attribution, audience targeting, and ad experiences.
facts.quote: in a survey conducted by eMarketer top CTV advertising pain points included measurement and attribution, audience targeting, and ad experiences.

facts.fact: Taptap Digital uses a method called georeferencing, linking on and offline datasets by where they occur, so media is focused on areas where target customers are concentrated rather than targeted individually.
facts.quote: based on the common unifier of where they occur through a method called georeferencing. Media investment is then focused on areas where their target customers are in high concentration

facts.fact: Taptap Digital's CTV launch is supported by a partnership with Mastercard Data and Insights, giving access to aggregated purchase data by geographic area.
facts.quote: In support of the CTV launch is a partnership with Mastercard Data and Insights. The partnership will allow access to aggregated purchase data by a range of geographic areas

facts.fact: Per Taptap Digital, leading brands Dyson and Taco Bell are already using its CTV solution, with more global brands ready to launch in Q2.
facts.quote: Leading brands like Dyson and Taco Bell are already using Taptap's CTV solution, with more global brands ready to launch in Q2.

facts.fact: Taptap Digital says advertisers can onboard and georeference custom data such as GRPs or first-party data.
facts.quote: Advertisers can onboard and georeference any custom data like GRPs or first party data for even more granularity and control.

facts.fact: The Taptap Digital article was published on 14 May 2024.
facts.quote:
Taptap Digital

14 May 2024

facts.fact: Taptap states it does not use a mailing list, retargeting, or ongoing data storage for enquiries unless the user asks to be kept in touch.
facts.quote: No mailing list, no retargeting, no ongoing data storage unless you ask us to keep in touch.

facts.fact: The World Bank forecast a 24% jump in energy prices in 2026, as cited by Taptap in its price shock article.
facts.quote: With the World Bank forecasting a 24% jump in energy prices this year

facts.fact: The Institute of Grocery Distribution (IGD) projected food inflation to hit over 8% by mid-2026, as cited by Taptap.
facts.quote: food inflation projected by the Institute of Grocery Distribution (IGD) to hit over 8% by mid-2026

facts.fact: A JCDecaux and Taptap Digital study found programmatic DOOH campaigns generate 0.0052 mg of CO2 emissions, per Taptap's post.
facts.quote: Programmatic DOOH is the media channel with the lowest environmental impact, generating 0.0052 mg of CO2 emissions

facts.fact: Taptap Digital announced its acquisition of Skyrise to expand its European footprint.
facts.quote: Taptap Digital Acquires Skyrise to Expand European Footprint and Accelerate Global Expansion

facts.fact: Taptap and TXT Media announced a partnership to bring geospatial audience planning and omnichannel activation to the MENA region.
facts.quote: TXT Media and Taptap Digital Partner to Bring Advanced Location Intelligence Solutions to the Middle East

facts.fact: According to analysis from the innovation foundation Nesta (a third-party source cited by Taptap), as little as 1% of total marketing spend may ultimately be lost as brands pivot toward exempt channels and brand-led strategies.
facts.quote: according to recent analysis from the innovation foundation Nesta, as little as 1% of total marketing spend may ultimately be lost

facts.fact: Through its integration with SSP1, Taptap Digital says advertisers can reach audiences via 75,000+ screens in high-traffic environments across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
facts.quote: advertisers can now reach audiences via 75,000+ screens in high-traffic environments across Germany, Austria and Switzerland

facts.fact: Álvaro del Castillo, Taptap's founder, is stepping down as CEO after almost 16 years to become non-executive President, with Álvaro Mayol appointed CEO.
facts.quote: Founder Álvaro del Castillo assumes non-executive Presidency after 16 years as CEO

facts.fact: According to Magnite Research, 78% of households across the UK, Germany, France, Italy and Spain watch CTV (third-party figure cited by Taptap Digital).
facts.quote: According to Magnite Research, 78% of households across the UK, Germany, France, Italy and Spain watch CTV.

facts.fact: Taptap Digital's area-based approach to CTV is described as having 4 phases: Audience, Area, Media and Moments.
facts.quote: we dove into the first two parts of our 4-phase area-based marketing approach.

facts.fact: Taptap Digital says its Audience phase uses 100s of on and offline georeferenced datasets to define and discover an ideal audience.
facts.quote: using 100s of on and offline georeferenced datasets which is then followed by phase 2 Area

facts.fact: Taptap Digital announced its entry into Kenya and Nigeria, which it describes as two of the fast-growing markets in the region.
facts.quote: announces the expansion of their business into Kenya and Nigeria, two of the fast-growing markets in the region.

facts.fact: Taptap Digital launched a CTV solution leveraging location intelligence for planning, activation and reporting.
facts.quote: Taptap Digital announces the launch of a new CTV solution leveraging the power of location intelligence

facts.fact: Taptap Digital joined the Mastercard Partner Network to enhance its area-based marketing offering.
facts.quote: has joined the Mastercard Partner Network to transform how businesses advertise.

facts.fact: Taptap Digital appointed Olivia Adams and Rob Morrison as Sales Directors in the UK to drive new business and expand advertiser and agency relationships.
facts.quote: announces the appointment of Olivia Adams and Rob Morrison as Sales Directors in the UK.

facts.fact: Taptap launched in Brazil with the appointment of Andrea Orsolon as VP of Business Development.
facts.quote: Taptap launches in Brazil with the appointment of Andrea Orsolon as VP of Business Development

facts.fact: Taptap Digital announced a partnership with League-M Europe to expand growth into Germany and the DACH region.
facts.quote: Taptap Digital announces partnership with League-M Europe to expand growth into Germany and the DACH region

facts.fact: Taptap Digital integrated programmatic audio into its omnichannel advertising offering through a partnership with Triton Digital.
facts.quote: Taptap today announces the integration with Triton Digital, the global technology and services leader to the digital audio

facts.fact: Movistar Plus+, Havas Media and Taptap Digital launched the first omnichannel campaign on new digital screens in Metro de Madrid in partnership with JCDecaux.
facts.quote: launch the first omnichannel campaign on new digital screens in Metro de Madrid in partnership with JCDecaux

facts.fact: Cinemark and Publicis Groupe launched a DOOH campaign in Lima using geo-referenced data from Taptap Digital.
facts.quote: Using geo-referenced data from Taptap Digital, this campaign is designed to engage consumers in an effective and relevant way.

facts.fact: Taptap Digital describes CTV as a powerful driver of advertising engagement and ROI, while noting fragmentation and standardisation challenges remain.
facts.quote: CTV is a powerful driver of advertising engagement and ROI; however, fragmentation and standardisation challenges remain.
